szoveg_eredeti:
We worked with the Hugging Face team to add read-only access to Trusted Publishers.

Baseten is now the first inference provider to pull private Hugging Face weights with short-lived, read-only tokens issued at deploy time over OIDC. This eliminates long-lived tokens that could leak, as well as unnecessary write access to your repo.

This joins our existing OIDC support for S3 and GCS. More posts in our security series to come. 

Full details in the blog: https://lnkd.in/d3ka3eHb

prioritas.lead_hu: A Baseten az első inferencia-szolgáltató, amely rövid élettartamú, csak olvasható tokenekkel teszi lehetővé a privát Hugging Face modell weights biztonságos elérését.
